source: Väestötietojärjestelmän suomalaisten nimiaineistot — Sukunimitilasto 2026-08-04 (Digi- ja väestötietovirasto)
note: Surnames in the Population Information System, counted. The figure is living Finnish citizens holding the name, resident in Finland OR ABROAD, which is why it reaches the emigration this atlas follows. COMPLETE ABOVE TWENTY AND SILENT BELOW IT: the DVV withholds any surname with fewer than twenty bearers for privacy — «Sellaisia sukunimiä joiden nimenhaltijoita on alle 20, ei esitetä tietosuojasyistä» — so a Finnish name absent here is far likelier to be rare than unknown, and absence must not be read as evidence. Recorded as refused in September, when avoindata.fi answered 403; the portal had moved to avoindata.suomi.fi and a redirect nobody followed reads exactly like a refusal.
